Sampling Unit Type.cell: Fraction of a bulk digestion — "Another 5% fraction was used to determine Al/Mg ratios by multi-collector (MC)-ICPMS"

Digestion Step.cell: Bulk and chondrule route, 1: 3:1 7 M HNO3 : 28 M HF in Parr bombs, 3 days (1 day at 150 deg C, 2 days at 210 deg C) | 2: dried down and taken up in aqua regia, 2 further days on a hotplate. Si route, 1: NaOH fusion in silver crucibles, 720 deg C, 13 min, the fusion cake dissolved in Milli-Q water and acidified with HNO3 -- a fusion rather than an acid digestion.

Digestion Temperature.cell: 150 deg C for 1 day then 210 deg C for 2 days (Parr bomb); hotplate for the aqua regia step; 720 deg C for the NaOH fusion (Si route). The 130 deg C 10 M HCl step previously recorded here is Cr(VI) speciation during column chemistry, not a digestion.

Digestion Duration.cell: 3 days in the Parr bomb (1 + 2 days) then 2 days in aqua regia; 13 min for the NaOH fusion. The 3 h and >1 week previously recorded here are Cr speciation during column chemistry.

Final Solution Matrix.cell: 0.5 M HNO3 (Cr); 6 M HCl elution of the final Cr cut

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes — AG1-X8 anion (1 ml) for Fe, then AG50-X12 cation (1 ml) twice for Cr and Mg

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Desolvation System.cell: ESI Apex HF with an actively cooled membrane unit (Cr); ESI Apex Omega (Mg)

Sample Uptake Rate.cell: 30 µl/min for Cr and for Mg
Sample Uptake Rate.value: 30 µl/min for Cr and for Mg

RF Power.cell: Stated qualitatively — measured "at low radiofrequency power and sample gas inflow" to reduce gas-based interferences

ICP Tuning.cell: Measured "at low radiofrequency power and sample gas inflow" deliberately, to reduce gas-based interferences

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Blank / Background Correction Method.value: On-peak baseline measurement preceding each analysis

Uncertainty Level.value: "the mean and 2 x standard error (SE) of ten individual standard-bracketed sample analyses"
